beats.label: Sodium vs potassium
beats.text: **Salt** is only **half** the blood pressure story.

beats.label: Sodium
beats.note: Fukagawa et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2026 (Univ. of Vermont)

beats.label: Potassium
beats.text: Helps kidneys **flush** sodium. Most diets get **far** too **little.**

beats.label: The big trial
beats.text: A potassium salt **swap:** **14%** fewer **strokes** in 21,000 high-risk adults.
beats.note: Salt Substitute and Stroke Study, NEJM 2021

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Trial was in rural **China.** Kidney disease or some meds? Potassium can be **risky.**
Follow for heart tips that come with **receipts.**
